name: flame-field
title: Flame Field
description: A slow field of flame drawn on the GPU in the page's accent color, soft, cheap, and still under reduced motion.

theme.shadow-gloss: inset 0 1px 0 0 var(--gloss-highlight), inset 0 -1px 0 0 var(--gloss-shade), 0 0 0 1px var(--gloss-edge), 0 1px 2px 0 var(--gloss-depth), 0 4px 12px -4px var(--gloss-depth)
theme.shadow-glass: inset 0 1px 0 0 var(--gloss-highlight), inset 0 -10px 24px -18px var(--gloss-shade), inset 0 0 0 1px var(--gloss-edge), 0 2px 6px -1px var(--gloss-depth), 0 18px 40px -12px var(--gloss-depth)
